hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The first true HYPE onset in the armed V57 run was opposed to the structural candidate side and failed the frozen compression and pullback prerequisites. The live backend and two observers produced semantically identical evaluations. Its causal completed-candle path had zero favorable excursion before crossing the 80-bps protective stop proxy, and the later sampled executable bid also crossed that level. This event supports the specific withholding decision but does not establish active-route expectancy.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A preregistered independent same-mechanism sample must become positive after exact costs and largest-winner removal, or contrary aligned-route evidence must show that the frozen gates systematically reject positive compatible lifecycles.
